name: Innyuu Milk Kissa ~Ura Menu o Meshiagare~
original_name: 淫乳・みるく喫茶～裏メニューをめしあがれ～
source:
The main character is a white-collar worker. One day, he visits a cafe and falls in love with a girl who works there. Her name is Miruku. He is completely attracted to her and visits the cafe frequently. Several months later, Miruku suddenly tells him a secret of the cafe, "There is a secret menu served only during midnight...."

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090220063906/http://www.erogeshop.com/product_info.php/products_id/1011899]ErogeShop[/url]]
